items.create:attribute_filter.tooltip.summary: _Matches items_ against a set of _attributes_ or _categories_. Can be used in _Filter Slots_ of Create's Components
items.create:blaze_cake.tooltip.summary: A Delicious treat for your hard-working _Blaze Burners_. Gets them all fired up!
items.create:builders_tea.tooltip.summary: The perfect drink to get the day started- _Motivating_ and _Saturating._
items.create:cardboard_sword.tooltip.summary: Bonk. A _mostly_ _harmless_, yet powerful weapon of choice.
items.create:copper_backtank.tooltip.behaviour: Provides _Pressurized_ _Air_ to Equipment that requires it.
_Collects_ _Pressurized_ _Air_ at a rate depending on the Rotational Speed.
items.create:copper_diving_boots.tooltip.behav: Wielder _descends_ more _quickly_ in liquids. Grants the ability to _walk_ and _jump_ underwater. Wielder also is no longer affected by _Mechanical_ _Belts_.
items.create:copper_diving_boots.tooltip.summa: A pair of _heavy_ _boots_, allowing for better traversal of the Ocean floor.
items.create:copper_diving_helmet.tooltip.beha: Provides the _Water Breathing_ effect, slowly draining _Air Pressure_ from the Backtank.
items.create:copper_diving_helmet.tooltip.summ: Together with a _Backtank_, allows the wielder to _breathe_ _underwater_ for an extended amount of time.
items.create:crafting_blueprint.behaviour1: Opens a _Crafting_ _menu_ allowing you to _configure_ a _recipe_ and items to display.
items.create:crafting_blueprint.behaviour2: _Applies_ the _configured_ _recipe_ with matching Ingredients found in your _Inventory_. _Sneak_ to craft up to a _Stack_ of items.
items.create:crafting_blueprint.tooltip.summar: _Placed_ on a wall, it can be used to _specify_ _ingredient_ _arrangements_ for easier manual crafting. Each slot represents a Recipe.
items.create:creative_blaze_cake.tooltip.summa: A very special treat for your _Blaze Burners_. After eating this cake, Blaze Burners will _never run out of fuel_.
items.create:empty_schematic.tooltip.summary: Used as a recipe ingredient and for writing at the _Schematic Table_.
items.create:experience_nugget.tooltip.summary: A speck of _inspiration_ from your fantastic inventions.
items.create:extendo_grip.tooltip.behaviour1: Increases _reach distance_ of items used in the _Main-Hand_.
items.create:extendo_grip.tooltip.behaviour2: _No_ _Durability_ will be used. Instead, _Air_ _pressure_ is drained from the Tank
items.create:extendo_grip.tooltip.summary: Greatly _increases reach distance_ of the wielder. Can be powered with _Air_ _Pressure_ from a _Backtank_
items.create:filter.tooltip.summary: _Matches items_ against a collection of _items_ or _other filters_. Can be used in _Filter Slots_ of Create's Components
items.create:goggles.tooltip.behaviour1: _Kinetic components_ show added _Stress Impact_ or _Capacity_. _Stressometers_ show statistics of their _attached kinetic network_. Some other blocks reveal information such as item and fluid content.
items.create:goggles.tooltip.summary: Augments your HUD with _miscellaneous information_ about placed components.
items.create:handheld_worldshaper.tooltip.beha: _Targeted block_ will become the _material_ placed by the shaper.
Applies currently selected _Brush_ and _Tool_ at the targeted location.
items.create:handheld_worldshaper.tooltip.summ: _Creative mode_ tool for large-scale _landscaping_ from a distance.
items.create:linked_controller.tooltip.behavio: _Toggles_ the controller. _Movement_ _controls_ are taken over while its active.
Enables _Bind Mode_, press one of the _six controls_ to bind it to the _Links' Frequency_.
Places the Controller into the Lectern for easy activation. (R-Click while Sneaking to retrieve it)
items.create:linked_controller.tooltip.summary: Grants _handheld_ _control_ over _Redstone Link_ frequencies assigned to its _six_ _buttons_.
items.create:minecart_coupling.tooltip.summary: _Chains_ together individual _Minecarts_, causing them to move as a group.
items.create:netherite_backtank.tooltip.behavi: Provides _Pressurized_ _Air_ to Equipment that requires it.
_Collects_ _Pressurized_ _Air_ at a rate depending on the Rotational Speed.
items.create:netherite_diving_boots.tooltip.be: Wielder _descends_ more _quickly_ in liquids. Grants the ability to _walk_ and _jump_ underwater. Wielder also is no longer affected by _Mechanical_ _Belts_.
items.create:netherite_diving_boots.tooltip.su: A pair of _heavy_ _boots_, allowing for better traversal of the Ocean floor, including Oceans made of Lava.
items.create:netherite_diving_helmet.tooltip.b: Provides immunity to _Fire_ and _Lava_, slowly draining _Air Pressure_ from the Backtank. Also grants _improved vision_ in Lava
items.create:netherite_diving_helmet.tooltip.s: Together with a _Netherite Backtank_, this can protect you from _extreme heat_. To be effective, _Legs and Feet_ have to be covered in _Netherite_, too.
items.create:package_filter.tooltip.summary: _Matches packaged items_ by their targeted _address_. Can be used in _Filter Slots_ of Create's Components
items.create:potato_cannon.tooltip.behaviour2: _No_ _Durability_ will be used. Instead, _Air_ _pressure_ is drained from the Tank
items.create:potato_cannon.tooltip.summary: Launches your home-grown vegetables at Enemies. Can be powered with _Air_ _Pressure_ from a _Backtank_
items.create:sand_paper.tooltip.behaviour1: Applies polish to items held in the _offhand_ or lying on the _floor_ when _looking at them_
items.create:sand_paper.tooltip.summary: Can be used to _refine materials_. The process can be automated with a Deployer.
items.create:schematic.tooltip.behaviour1: Can be positioned using the Tools on Screen.
items.create:schematic.tooltip.summary: Holds a structure to be positioned and placed into the world. Position the Hologram as desired and use a _Schematicannon_ to build it.
items.create:schematic_and_quill.tooltip.behav: Select two _corner points_ using _R-Click_. Hold _Ctrl_ and Scroll to select locations mid-air.
_Ctrl-Scroll_ on the faces to adjust the size, then R-Click again to Save.
items.create:schematic_and_quill.tooltip.summa: Used for _saving a Structure_ in your world to a _.nbt file_.
items.create:tree_fertilizer.tooltip.behaviour: Creates a tree _regardless_ of its _spacing conditions_
items.create:tree_fertilizer.tooltip.summary: A powerful combination of minerals useful for _growing saplings_ in tight spaces.
items.create:wand_of_symmetry.tooltip.behaviou: _Creates_ or _Moves_ its Mirror. _Sneak_ while using to open the _Configuration Interface_
items.create:wand_of_symmetry.tooltip.summary: _Mirrors Block placement_ while present in any _Hotbar Slot_.
items.create:wrench.tooltip.behaviour1: _Rotates components_ around the clicked face. _Sneak_ while interacting to _dismantle_ components.
items.create:wrench.tooltip.summary: Multi-purpose tool for working with your kinetic contraptions.

blocks.create:clipboard.tooltip.behaviour1: Opens the _Interface_. _Sneak-Click_ to _place_ it on a surface.
blocks.create:clipboard.tooltip.behaviour2: Some blocks' _settings_, such as filters, can be _copied (R-Click)_ and _applied (L-Click)_ elsewhere.
blocks.create:clipboard.tooltip.summary: _Keeps your notes_ and makes you look more professional.
blocks.create:controller_rail.tooltip.summary: A _uni-directional_ powered rail with _variable speed_, controlled by the _signal strength_ supplied to it.
blocks.create:copycat_panel.tooltip.behaviour1: Applies _held item_ as its _material_ if possible. _Click again_ to cycle _orientation_ or _powered_ state. Use a _Wrench_ to _reset_ the material.
blocks.create:copycat_panel.tooltip.summary: _Converts_ any _full block_ into a decorative panel. Also accepts _Bars_ and _Trapdoors_.
blocks.create:copycat_step.tooltip.behaviour1: Applies _held item_ as its _material_ if possible. _Click again_ to cycle _orientation_ or _powered_ state. Use a _Wrench_ to _reset_ the material.
blocks.create:copycat_step.tooltip.summary: _Converts_ any _full block_ into a decorative step.
blocks.create:creative_crate.tooltip.behaviour1: Anything _extracting_ from this container will provide an _endless supply_ of the item specified. Items _inserted_ into this crate will be _voided._
blocks.create:creative_crate.tooltip.behaviour2: Provides any material required by the Schematic.
blocks.create:creative_crate.tooltip.summary: This _Storage Container_ allows infinite replication of items.
blocks.create:cuckoo_clock.tooltip.behaviour1: Shows the _current time_ and plays a tune twice a day. _Activates_ once at _noon_ and at dusk, as soon as _players can sleep_.
blocks.create:cuckoo_clock.tooltip.summary: Fine craftsmanship for _decorating_ a space and _keeping track of time_.
blocks.create:desk_bell.tooltip.behaviour1: _Plays a sound_ when arriving at the _target floor_.
blocks.create:desk_bell.tooltip.summary: Ring for Service! Emits a _redstone signal_ when activated.
blocks.create:flywheel.tooltip.summary: _Embellish_ your _Machines_ with this imposing Wheel of Brass.
blocks.create:haunted_bell.tooltip.behaviour1: Highlights nearby _Lightless Spots_ on which _Hostile Mobs_ can spawn.
blocks.create:haunted_bell.tooltip.summary: A _Cursed Bell_ haunted by lost souls of the Nether.
blocks.create:item_hatch.tooltip.behaviour1: _Deposits_ your _held item_ into the _container_ it is placed on. _Sneak-click_ to _deposit_ _everything_ except Hotbar items.
blocks.create:item_hatch.tooltip.summary: _Quickly solves_ your _inventory_ clutter and makes it someone else's problem.
blocks.create:metal_bracket.tooltip.summary: _Decorate_ your _Shafts, Cogwheels_ and _Pipes_ with an industrial and sturdy bit of reinforcement.
blocks.create:nozzle.tooltip.summary: Attach to the front of an _Encased Fan_ to distribute its effect on Entities in _all directions_.
blocks.create:peculiar_bell.tooltip.summary: A decorative _Brass Bell_. Placing it right above open _Soul Fire_ may have side-effects...
blocks.create:placard.tooltip.behaviour1: _Adds_ the held _item_ to the Placard. _Emits_ a brief _Redstone_ signal if a matching item was present already.
blocks.create:placard.tooltip.summary: _Frame_ your _items_ in brass using this fancy wall panel. Safe for contraptions!
blocks.create:redstone_link.tooltip.summary: Rubies: Click on another Link to pair them up. Supports various types of Link. Click the air to unlink.
blocks.create:schematic_table.tooltip.behaviour: Uploads a chosen File from your Schematics Folder.
blocks.create:schematic_table.tooltip.summary: Writes saved Schematics onto an _Empty Schematic_.
blocks.create:schematicannon.tooltip.summary: Shoots blocks to recreate a deployed _Schematic_ in the World. Uses items from adjacent Inventories and _Gunpowder_ as fuel.
blocks.create:seat.tooltip.behaviour1: Sits the player on the _Seat_. Press L-shift to leave the _Seat_.
blocks.create:seat.tooltip.summary: Sit yourself down and enjoy the ride! Will anchor a player onto a moving _contraption_. Great for static furniture too! Comes in a variety of colours.
blocks.create:toolbox.tooltip.behaviour2: _Nearby_ _Players_ can hold the _Toolbox_ _Keybind_ to access its contents _Remotely_.
blocks.create:toolbox.tooltip.summary: Every Inventors' dearest Companion. Conveniently _holds_ a large amount of _8 Different_ item types.
blocks.create:turntable.tooltip.summary: Uses _Rotational Force_ to create Motion Sickness.
blocks.create:wooden_bracket.tooltip.summary: _Decorate_ your _Shafts, Cogwheels_ and _Pipes_ with a cozy and wooden bit of reinforcement.
